placements.title: Remember returns immediately, extraction proceeds async
placements.theme: The remember operation dispatches work and returns a receipt in seconds while extraction is watched by cursor polling or reaction piggyback, so no call blocks and no work is lost if the client drops the receipt.
placements.why: src-1 ratifies the contract — receipt return, cursor polling, no blocking, no lost work — and src-2 fills the retrieval-mechanism gap by specifying that the agent polls the run or receives the reaction piggybacked on a later call. Together they name a thematic subject — the async remember contract — that future envelopes will keep feeding, passing the narrative grain test. No existing leaf holds this theme, so it is minted under the Architecture strata.
